title: add benchmark-lab telemetry enhancements and reporting pipeline improvements
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: improve observability and reduce end-to-end reporting latency for Benchmark Lab runs. This PR introduces a v2 telemetry schema, adds richer representative-runner metadata (workload tags, kv-cache-hit ratios, batch size distributions), and optimizes the reporting pipeline to emit incremental summaries to the analytics store instead of batching full-run artifacts. The changes reduce downstream processing time and enable finer-grained regression detection in the dashboard.

What changed (high level):
- telemetry schema v2 (adds workload_id, runner_labels, kv_cache_stats, batch_size_histogram, partial_run_marker)
- representative workload runners emit new fields and a lightweight incremental checkpointing payload
- reporting pipeline: streaming summarizer service that consumes checkpoints, produces aggregated metrics hourly, and fallbacks to full-run ingestion when checkpoints are missing
- dashboards and alerts updated to use the new aggregated metrics (latency P50/P95, tokens/sec, kv_cache_hit_rate, model_quant_profile)
- docs and example config for running representative runners locally and in CI

Checklist:
- [x] schema defined and backwards-compatible (v1 -> v2 converters provided)
- [x] runner instrumentation implemented and tested with unit tests
- [x] reporting pipeline integration tests and small scale e2e smoke tests
- [x] dashboards updated and smoke-validated against synthetic data
- [x] Linear tickets linked and release notes drafted

Why this is safe: v2 schema includes optional fields and we ship a converter so older consumers that do not understand v2 will continue to ingest v1-like payloads. The incremental summarizer runs behind a feature flag and falls back to the existing ingestion path during rollout. Performance improvements are opt-in for the first rollout.

Rollout plan: enable summarizer for internal benchmark lab runs for 48 hours, validate aggregated metrics against the canonical full-run ingest for the same runs, then enable for external nightly CI runs. Feature flag: benchmark.telemetry.summarizer.v2

Linked work: Linear ENG-10721, ENG-10840, PM-893
